service.name: web-console
service.description: Standalone browser terminal with pane-based workspaces, PTY-backed session durability, AI command generation, configurable launch shortcuts, and mobile-first floating toolbar

hostTools.name: tmux
hostTools.reason: Enable persistent detachable sessions that survive web-console restarts
hostTools.notes: Web console falls back to the standard PTY backend when tmux is unavailable

steps.name: build-api
steps.run: cd api && GOWORK=off go mod download && GOWORK=off go build -o web-console-api .

develop.description: Launch API and Vite dev server

steps.name: start-api
steps.description: Start Go API server in background (export WC_BROADCAST_TRACE=1 before a restart to capture broadcast fingerprints; it logs every PTY frame and grows the log by gigabytes per day)

steps.name: register-tts-hook
steps.description: Register Claude Code Stop hook for auto-TTS

test.description: Execute phased test suite via test-genie

steps.name: run-tests
steps.description: Run all test phases via test-genie

steps.name: sync-validation
steps.description: Sync requirement validations to phase-results for scoring

capabilities.offline_limitations: AI features require Ollama (local) or OpenRouter (cloud); audio features are owned by audio-tools
capabilities.ai_note: Ollama preferred (free+local); OpenRouter used when Ollama unavailable

ollama.description: Local LLM provider for AI command generation (primary; falls back to OpenRouter)
ollama.degraded_behavior: AI generation falls back to OpenRouter when Ollama is unavailable

openrouter.description: Cloud LLM provider (BYOK) for AI command generation; used as the fallback when Ollama is unavailable. Model selection resolves through resource-openrouter policy roles.
openrouter.degraded_behavior: AI generation is unavailable only if both Ollama and OpenRouter are unreachable; OpenRouter requires OPENROUTER_API_KEY.

audio-tools.description: All audio capabilities (TTS synthesis, voice listing, summarization, STT/transcription, speaker verification, wake word) flow through audio-tools via audioports.Remote* and the shared browser capture package. web-console contains zero audio synthesis or transcription code.
audio-tools.degraded_behavior: Terminal workspace boots without audio-tools. Voice, TTS, summarization, speaker verification, and wake word features show degraded/unavailable until audio-tools is reachable, then recover on the next lazy resolution or capability refresh.

notes.storage_strategy: Embedded SQLite in the API process for workspace layout, shortcuts, and AI provider config
